tier_rationale: Direct controlled BWA/ASAN fuzzing evidence from the canonical preserved campaign; one principal software version/configuration without meaningful independent replication.
Two directly observed ASAN-confirmed source-level root causes within one BWA software audit; distinct root causes do not by themselves constitute independent replication.
Direct ASAN-confirmed ksw_extend2 out-of-bounds-read finding in the recovered controlled BWA audit; not independently replicated.
Direct ASAN-confirmed mem_aln2sam out-of-bounds-read finding in the recovered controlled BWA audit; not independently replicated.
Direct nanopore signal perturbation and basecalling experiment under a controlled seed-42 Gaussian dose-response.
The Gaussian dose-response was reproduced across five independent random seeds at multiple perturbation strengths.
Direct empirical alignment measurement following controlled ONT signal perturbation; not independently replicated as the primary claim represented by this row.
The W0 target-only condition was tested at two independent heterozygous loci, L2 and L3, with 10 parents at each locus and the same null target-state result at both loci.
Direct F11 pathogenic-variant signal-perturbation experiment across controlled conditions, but restricted to one locus, one individual and one principal experimental system.
Direct controlled PM2 perturbation of the clean-confirmed F11 ALT-supporting parents.
Observed downstream variant-call consequence in the controlled F11 experiment; this is not evidence of real clinical ingestion or patient harm.
Matched off-target sham control within the same F11 experimental case, strengthening causal interpretation without constituting external replication.
Synthetic kinship-graph construction output. The graph-size result is deterministic for the configured model and seed but is not itself externally calibrated evidence.
Synthetic graph-amplification model was tuned against the reported 23andMe amplification target and achieved 464.4-fold with 5.8 percent calibration error.
Unrecoverability values are produced by the project's internal entropy-leakage model and have not been externally calibrated.
Lifetime re-identification trajectory is a project simulation based on configured database-growth and inference assumptions.
Familial-risk saturation is produced by the internal lifetime risk model and is not externally population-calibrated.
Containment effectiveness is measured on the project's synthetic kinship graph without external containment calibration.
Authentication metrics come from an internally generated credential-stuffing benchmark rather than an external dataset.
Threshold 4.5 is the committed project's internal operational configuration and is not externally optimized or validated.
